newsitem.title: UK: Cyprus $200-$300 mln five-year bond due Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus $200-$300 mln five-year bond due Thursday.

text.p: Cyprus will launch a debut Eurobond for $200 to $300 million with a five-year maturity on Thursday, a central bank official said on Wednesday.
"The bond will be for between $200 and $300 million, and have a five-year maturity," Ioannis Ioannou, head of the external debt section at the Central Bank of Cyprus said at a meeting in London.
"The bond will be priced to yield in the mid-30s basis points over U.S. Treasury notes, but we are waiting further feedback from investors (on the exact pricing)," he said.
The bond will be lead managed by SBC Warburg and issued under Cyprus' recently established $500 million EMTN programme.
Proceeds will be used to refinance existing debt and to fund development projects.
"The bond will be a benchmark for Cyprus and we will see how it does in the market," Ioannou said.
He said it was unlikely Cyprus would launch any further bonds this year.
